title: Define external agent runner connector and stream mapping boundaries
description: AstrBot supports non-standard agent runners such as Coze, Dify, DashScope, and DeerFlow. Their API clients, thread/session mapping, stream event parsing, final response mapping, and runner lifecycle should not be folded into chat provider adapters or the generic AgentRunner.

files.change: Define connector config, client lifecycle, stream event mapping, final response mapping, and provider-request adaptation.
Route external agent configs into agent connectors without treating them as normal chat providers.

criteria: External agent runner state is testable without pipeline stages.
Provider adapters remain focused on provider protocol, not third-party agent workflow state.
Streaming deltas and final results are normalized through agent response types.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-agent && cargo test -p astrbot-runtime && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
